remarks: Spacious 1 Bedroom, 1 1/2 Bath condo, with a large Loft, located in a very desirable and convenient complex, Foxboro Court. The unit boasts hardwood floors in the living room, dining room, kitchen and bedroom. The living room features a vaulted ceiling, woodburning fireplace and a door out to the spacious deck. Overlooking the living room is a large loft, with a skylight, vaulted ceiling and new wall to wall carpeting. The loft is perfect for a home office or a tv room. Lots of possibilities! The kitchen comes with custom made cabinets, stainless steel appliances, granite countertops and a breakfast bar. The spacious bedroom has a full bath and a large walk-in closet. There is storage space in the basement and access to the spacious garage. Foxboro Ct is conveniently located near major highways, shopping, restaurants, transportation and much more. Please remove shoes in entryway...brand new carpet!!
